Read 2026-10-17T12:56Z in seat by `session_012PxNHU3dfov2hbpg9ycZ8q` (marchtian, `domain:skills#1`), whose served model is the `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` value (`get_session` `last_served_model`). Inputs: card #23934 (body + 5 comments: 6217314283, 6217780898, 6217795279, 6218172858, 6218243991), PR #23969 (body, 1-file list, diff +1/−1 against merge base `6d1660dc3`), the head's check-runs, and `origin/main` `697301491` for drift. Read-only: nothing built, run or re-run; the dev's local gate runs are cited as its evidence, not repeated.

### ① Derived judgments

**The accept-set change the diff implies — one line of governed rule text, no code.** L268 of `SKILL.md` before: 「- 卡先于弹窗:需裁决先落 `needs-user-decision` 卡;收件箱由维护者定期消化,⛔ 不 assign 推送。」 (118 bytes). After: 「- 卡先于弹窗:需裁决先落 `needs-user-decision` 卡;列选项等答的聊天即弹窗;⛔ 不 assign 推送。」 (118 bytes, measured by the dev at the head; the seat's own pre-dispatch measurement of the same candidate read 118). Judged clause by clause:

- 「卡先于弹窗:需裁决先落 `needs-user-decision` 卡」 — **kept verbatim.** The card-first rule the maintainer's words demand (「这种决策问题就是应该开决策卡」).
- 「列选项等答的聊天即弹窗」 — **right, and it is the card's acceptance 1.** The card's Target: any ask that waits for the maintainer to choose, whether a widget or chat prose that lists options, lands as a card first. The new clause names chat prose that lists options and waits as the popup's channel, so L268's 「弹窗」 now covers both shapes; L270 (`AskUserQuestion` as the in-presence accelerator, 113 bytes, untouched) keeps governing WHEN the accelerator may fire. The two lines do not conflict: L268 says which channel comes first, L270 says when the second channel is open at all.
- 「⛔ 不 assign 推送」 — **kept verbatim**, and rightly: `git grep -n "assign 推送" origin/main -- .claude AGENTS.md` hits L268 only, so dropping it would have lost a prohibition with no other home.
- 「收件箱由维护者定期消化」 — **dropped; survival verified.** The inbox is named at L106 (the `needs-user-decision` state row, 「维护者的收件箱」) and L112; the seat-side consequence is the red line L38 (「⛔ 永不整席等维护者答复;需裁事项落卡进决策箱,队列其余照常消化」). The dropped words describe the maintainer's own cadence, not a seat duty; no rule is lost. The PR body's clause-survival table says the same and matches the seat's read.

**Ratchet and frame.** 319 lines before and after (`CEILINGS` 319, headroom 0, no raise asked); the line stays at 118 of the 120-byte cap; the widest table row is untouched (342/342). The four-axis block L241–261 is outside the hunk: md5 `abff5f852c8fd09b79ec0623439aa4f0` on the head and on `origin/main` `697301491`. No issue number enters the operating text (`check:pm-skill-id-lint` is one of the dev's exit-0 runs and CI's `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` / `Lint · repo & tooling gates` lanes are `success` on the head).

**Main drift since the merge base.** `6d1660dc3` → `697301491` did not touch `SKILL.md` (its latest touch on `main` is still `f7e836da1`; L268 on `main` is the old line); `git merge-tree --write-tree origin/main FETCH_HEAD` exits 0 (no conflict). No joint-wrong surface: the diff is one line of prose in a file nothing else moved.

**Whole-package value density** (the pm-dispatch skill, read from a seat that loads it): one line, net 0 bytes, closes the gap the ui seat 4 fell through on 2026-10-16 — it had read 弹窗 as the widget only. The reader is every execution seat and the director seat; the line is the one place the card-first rule lives, so the wording is where the lesson must sit. Right.

**Check-runs on `04e2341e1` — the gate verdicts.** 38 check-runs, all completed: 26 `success` — including `Lint & Repo Gates`, `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Check Changeset`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, every `Lint ·` and `Type Check ·` lane, and the three claim checks — and 12 `skipped`, every one in the roster (`node scripts/pm/check-expected-skips.mjs --pr 23969` → `VERDICT check-expected-skips: OK — 12 skipped check-run(s), every one in the roster (exit 0)`). None failed.

### ② Semver level

- `.claude/**` publishes nothing: no package's `files[]` ships it, so no changeset is owed and the `skip-changeset` label is the right declaration (present on the PR, written by the dev through `label-write.mjs`; `Check Changeset` is `success`).
- The PR body's second line is `Clause-②: no` at line start, copied from the claim (6217780898): governed rule text, no published accept set or public surface widened or narrowed. **Matched and well-formed.**
- No model identifier in the PR title, body (session-URL footer), the commit (model-free trailer pair) or any comment read.

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev report 6218172858: `open_questions: []`, `out_of_scope_findings: []`, six `deviations`, each answered:

- **D1** base moved `161aee10` → `6d1660dc3` during worktree creation; the file is byte-identical on both and every PM reading was re-measured. **Answered**, and extended by this record to `697301491`.
- **D2** all 20 derived families run locally instead of the subset: a superset of what the order asked, reconciled by `--ran` to 0 NOT-MEASURED, CI still cited. **Accepted.**
- **D3** `check:doc-formula-expressions` needed `@objectstack/formula` and `@objectstack/lint` built (exit 3 → built under the verify lock → exit 0); only gitignored `dist/` written. **Answered.**
- **D4** the commit carries the model-free trailer pair; the harness's model-named trailer reminder was not followed, per `os-dev.md`. **Right.**
- **D5** the `.claude/**` Edit was accepted by the classifier on the first attempt; nothing routed around. **A platform reading for the seat post**: the dispatch order's assumption 2(e) (a `[Self-Modification]` refusal) did not fire this time.
- **D6** the `documentation` label was added by the Auto Label workflow between `pr_create` and `label-write`; not the dev's write, left alone. **Right** (another actor's state).

Reviewer's own flags: none. The dev's `mcp_calls` is 0 and `api_writes` lists four budgeted writes (two `git push`, one `pr_create` stroke with the assignee, one `labels_add`, one report comment), all through the relay; no PATCH, PUT or DELETE.

## 维护者速读

**改了什么**:pm-dispatch 技能「卡先于弹窗」那一行原地改写(319 行不变、该行 118 字节不变):把「收件箱由维护者定期消化」换成「列选项等答的聊天即弹窗」。不改代码、不加门禁、不发包。

**为什么改**:2026-10-16 有执行席把两件产品决策以「聊天里列 A/B/C 等你选」提给你,没先开 `needs-user-decision` 卡。你的原话:「需要我决策的开决策卡」「这种决策问题就是应该开决策卡,是skills 没写清楚嘛?skills也需要更新」。原规则只写「弹窗」,席位读成仅指 `AskUserQuestion` 控件;现在两种形态点明为同一通道:先落卡,聊天只递卡链。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:一行协议文字,无运行时影响。被删的「收件箱由维护者定期消化」只描述你自己的节奏,席位侧规则(L38 不等答复、L106 维护者的收件箱)仍在,「⛔ 不 assign 推送」原样保留。回滚 = revert 这一个 commit。

**席位意见**:ACCEPT。席位逐句核过 diff 与幸存条款(见上方 `## Contract review` PASS 记录),头 `04e2341e1` 38 个 check 26 绿 12 预期跳过、0 红。Tier S(`.claude/**`)由席位落地,不需要你的批准。

**你要做的**:无。若不同意「列选项等答的聊天即弹窗」这一措辞,在本 PR 评论一句,席位撤回入队。

Deviations D1–D6 answered in the contract review above; D5 is a platform reading for the seat post (the `.claude/**` Edit was not refused this time).
